scope: Live trusted declarations, not full rollout acceptance; 2026-09-16 batch 1: Uniswap V4 BNB and GMX Arbitrum promoted under the scoped-promotion amendment; 2026-09-17 batch 2: Uniswap V3 Avalanche and Polygon admitted to verified fork/backtest; 2026-09-23: Uniswap V3 BNB and Robinhood, PancakeSwap V3 BNB and Uniswap V4 Robinhood promoted to production by maintainer acceptance on hosted fork qualification and staging evidence, before their complete per-cell packages (see AGENTS.md); 2026-09-23 second batch: Uniswap V3 Avalanche and Polygon, Uniswap V4 Polygon and Curve Optimism and Base promoted to production by maintainer acceptance on hosted fork qualification and lane evidence, before their complete per-cell packages (see AGENTS.md); 2026-09-24 third batch: Uniswap V3 Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base and Optimism, Uniswap V4 Arbitrum, Base and Optimism, PancakeSwap V3 Ethereum, Arbitrum and Base, Aerodrome Base and Aerodrome Slipstream Base promoted to production by maintainer acceptance on hosted fork qualification and lane evidence, before their complete per-cell packages (see AGENTS.md); 2026-09-24 fourth batch: Morpho Blue Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, Robinhood, BNB and Avalanche, Compound V3 Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum and Optimism and SparkLend Ethereum promoted to production by maintainer acceptance on hosted fork qualification, before their complete per-cell packages (see AGENTS.md); 2026-09-24: Aave V3 Arbitrum, Avalanche, Base, BNB, Optimism and Polygon promoted to production under the scoped-promotion amendment on complete per-cell packages; 2026-10-20: Morpho Blue HyperEVM (eip155:999) admitted to fork, backtest and production by maintainer acceptance on its reference lifecycle, rehearsal and prepared backtest evidence, before its complete per-cell package (see AGENTS.md); D7 (maintainer acceptance on merging its declaration): Hyperliquid HyperEVM (eip155:999) admitted to production, Safe/Roles only, on its fork lifecycle, production rehearsal and read-only mainnet checks, with one maintainer-run mainnet lifecycle as its promotion evidence (see AGENTS.md)

Production (D7): T1 (an agent cannot move value out of the account) and the open half of T4 (an unknownOid after expiry is final) are production assumptions; an Ioc order whose answer is lost and which shows nothing past its expiry halts with its evidence.
Production: the provider must serve HyperEVM's head exactly; Alchemy runs reads pinned near its head at head + 1, which the gateway refuses (blueprint 29).
Backtests: HyperCore /info trade candles and hourly funding (D4); the venue serves only its latest 5000 candles of an interval.
Cross margin on first-dex perps at the configured leverage; Ioc entries and reduce-only Ioc exits. Backtests refuse positions above the first margin tier or 100,000 USDC of notional.
Backtests model book, mark and oracle prices from trade candles.
A dedicated Safe whose HyperCore account the strategy owns; the agent can trade every market of it (D2), and the gateway alone enforces the configured market and sizes.
The Safe owners fund the HyperCore HYPE that pays each withdrawal's system transaction; a withdrawal it cannot pay for stops before anything is sent.
